title: French intellectual and inventor of 'cinema verité' Edgar Morin dies at 104
summary: French intellectual Edgar Morin has died at the age of 104, his wife said Saturday. The World War II Resistance member dedicated his life to promoting critical thinking and combatting intolerance.
